objects.prompt: Create ONE isolated transparent pixel-art sprite: strict TOP orthographic view looking straight down +Z of the exact Ghost Cemetery Temple of Yemaya shrine from the source/front/side references. Source is the sole identity, palette, and detail authority; preserve its blue-water shrine, pale masonry, gold/coral details and source layout. Accepted right/left views show the object's front-to-back thickness is much smaller than the facade width; match that exact shallow depth: the top footprint must be a long horizontal rectangle about 2.0 to 2.2 times wider than its front-to-back depth, never a square. Place a shallow forward semicircular basin at the FRONT edge, a narrow shell/ridge cap at the REAR edge, compact deity/head/cross-section only at the back, four gold corner-cap footprints, and side-candle top marks. Looking straight down: no full frontal deity/face, no radial shell ribs standing upright, no vertical pillars or facade triangles. The object is a thin upright shrine panel with a shallow base, not a large floor shrine. Use crisp original-style pixel art with clean transparent margins.

Create ONE isolated transparent pixel-art sprite: strict TOP orthographic view looking straight down +Z of the exact Ghost Havana El Capitolio entrance facade. The source is the only identity/material/palette authority: preserve the gold dome, teal-and-gold facade materials, and source-supported palm positions. The accepted front view is broad and the accepted side views show a shallow depth; top footprint must be a long shallow roof rectangle, about 2.3 to 2.5 times wider along X than its Y depth. Use a low, shallow roof/cornice plan with a centered circular dome cap of plausible source width; palms become small compact overhead crown marks at the same lateral positions. No frontal facade, columns, windows, doorways, or upright palm trunks are visible from overhead. Match the narrow underside footprint visible in the accepted BOTTOM. Do not produce a square building plan. Crisp pixel art, transparent margins.

Create ONE isolated transparent pixel-art sprite: strict TOP orthographic view looking straight down +Z of the exact Ghost Havana old arcade frontage. Source is the only design, material, and identity authority. Preserve the long gold-and-teal roofline, its source-count rooftop finials, and the same positions. The overhead plan must be a very shallow long-X rectangle, about 3.2 times wider than its Y depth, matching the BOTTOM strip's footprint. Show only roof/coping surfaces and compact finial top facets; no upright windows, doors, balcony faces, or full facade. Do not make a square roof or show upper floors as vertical walls. Crisp original-style pixel art, transparent margins.
